# Inactive upstream workflow definitions

These original definitions are retained byte-for-byte for upstream provenance and
comparison, outside GitHub Actions' active `workflows/` directory. Their relative
workflow references remain historical and they are not runnable from here.

The macOS repository enables only `.github/workflows/macos-preview-release.yml`.
Do not move upstream Windows releases, label automation or unrelated maintainer
publishing into the active directory without a scoped review.
